build_SpeechDLM_model: build a SpeechDLM model instance using build_model with args and task
build_SpeechDLM_embedding: build a token embedding layer using build_embedding with dictionary and embed_dim
load_SpeechDLM_pretrained: load a pretrained SpeechDLM model from a checkpoint file using from_pretrained
configure_SpeechDLMConfig: configure SpeechDLM hyperparameters using the SpeechDLMConfig dataclass with decoder layers and dimensions
register_speech_dlm_big_architecture: register the speech_dlm_big architecture with 12 decoder layers and 1024 embedding dimension
